lessons_used: Predictions remain consistently too high, overestimating positive impact across all 9 tests.
sign_in hint changes have shown no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign as its 2 tests do not agree (one won, one had no clear effect).
Evidence remains thin for choose_path layout, finish copy, finish new_screen, home notification, and home wait_info as each has only one test so far.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Path Selector
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen into a story scroll layout with interactive mascot elements to guide path selection.
candidates.why: choose_path has a 76.2% conversion rate and a high mean duration of 514s, indicating hesitation during initial path selection.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose_path while retaining all required functionality within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path drops 23.8% of users with long duration; previous layout change had modest +1.5% gain.

candidates.title: Grid Layout Account Authentication
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a structured grid layout highlighting cloud data persistence and restore security.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in, and sign_in currently drops 27.1% of users.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Secure Your Pet Companion
sign_in.body: Keep your pet saved securely across sessions and prevent progress loss.

components.text: Sign in with your account to maintain continuous pet access.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the sign_in screen structure.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel drop (27.1%) and 8 support emails point here, but sign_in changes historically yield minimal lift.

candidates.title: Companion Customization Preview Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated pet preview confirmation screen prior to generating the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (66.2%) and a long mean duration of 1017s, plus support received 3 emails about custom pet generation issues.

new_pet_preview.headline: Preview Your Desktop Companion
new_pet_preview.body: Review your pet appearance before signing the official certificate.

guard.reason: Adding a new preview confirmation screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption loses 33.8% and has support tickets, but adding extra screens previously reduced conversion (-8.1%).

candidates.title: Desktop Render Waiting Progress Info
candidates.change: Display active render progress indicators and desktop interaction tips while waiting for pet generation.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, and support logs note user confusion when pets do not appear right away.

components.text: Desktop pets hang out around open windows when active.

guard.reason: Adding rendering progress indicators and carousel tips to waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High wait time and support logs confirm issue, but previous wait_info test resulted in a -1.0% drop.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Controls Checklist Flow
candidates.change: Embed a structured interactive controls checklist sub-flow into home_intro to teach desktop interaction.
candidates.why: Finish drops 35.2% of users with a high mean duration of 5815s, while support received multiple emails about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.headline: Master Desktop Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Complete these quick steps to start interacting with your pet on screen.

components.text: Right-click pet to open context menu
Press shortcut to hide or show pet anytime
Click pet directly to initiate dialogue

guard.reason: Adding interactive controls checklist sub-flow to home_intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish drops 35.2% and support notes confusion, but adding sub-flows/new screens introduces significant drop-off.

candidates.title: Path Duration & Expectation Copy
candidates.change: Update the choose_path screen copy to set clear expectations on setup duration and flexibility.
candidates.why: The mean time on choose_path is 514s despite an 8s median, indicating long-tail user hesitation.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Journey (Takes 1 Minute)
choose_path.body: Pick an instant pet template or build a custom desktop friend.
choose_path.hint: You can change pet styles anytime later from options.

guard.reason: Valid copy update that maintains the required path choices.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change to address long tail hesitation, supported by funnel duration data.

candidates.title: Post-Selection Account Authentication Order
candidates.change: Move the sign_in step after pet selection so users establish emotional investment before signing in.
candidates.why: sign_in experiences a 27.1% drop early in the process; asking for authentication after pick_friend increases completion motivation.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in after pet selection is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Delaying authentication builds user investment before sign_in, addressing 27.1% drop-off.

candidates.title: Spotlight Adoption Certificate Display
candidates.change: Replace the certificate section on adoption_certificate with a high-impact spotlight seal and frame design.
candidates.why: Adoption has low conversion (66.2%) and a mean time of 1017s; a cleaner spotlight layout reinforces completion momentum.

guard.reason: replacement for 'adoption_certificate.certificate' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'preview'] with an asset:certificate/ asset

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Spawn Notification
candidates.change: Enable background ready notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet rendering completes.
candidates.why: Mean duration on the waiting screen reaches 2336s, indicating users minimize or walk away while pet initialization finishes.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Pet
waiting.body: You can keep working. We will send a system alert when your companion lands on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding system notification options to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses long wait time (2336s mean), but home notification previously showed -0.4% change.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Welcome Starter Incentive
candidates.change: Add an unlocked starter gift badge and animated item preview to the final welcome intro screen.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding finish rate is only 19.4%, so adding a clear initial reward encourages users to complete setup.

home_intro.headline: Onboarding Complete! Here is Your Starter Pack

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions gifts and free extras ('Starter Pack', 'Unlocked: Golden Desk Toy').

lessons_next: Predictions tended to overestimate positive impact in early rounds, but underestimated positive gains in round 3 winning tests.

Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign as its 2 tests do not agree (one won, one had no clear effect).
Evidence remains thin for home wait_info as its 2 tests do not agree (one had no clear effect, one won).
